review.note: Release 0.9.2 dependency review on 2026-10-25: the following official release notes were manually reviewed for these exact versions in the preceding 0.9.1 release and re-assessed for this schema identity patch; the canonical generator performs fresh registry queries and every latest version must match this reviewed set before commit. hatchling 1.32.4: Reviewed restored build-hook generic compatibility and version-metadata whitespace correction; no custom build hook or bound change required. Official notes: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/. distlib 0.4.4: Reviewed launcher write errors, ScriptMaker shebang detection and archive containment/data_filter changes. Windows launcher execution remains native-platform validation; this release adds no launcher changes. Official notes: https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib. packaging 26.3: Reviewed requirement/marker normalization and exception corrections, VersionRange additions and Python >=3.9. Existing PEP 440/508 parser use remains supported; no replacement parser or tighter bound needed. Official notes: https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. build 1.6.1: Reviewed Windows symlink-probe regression correction and normal sdist-derived build flow; the repository uses the CLI, not the removed BuildBackendException exc_info API. Official notes: https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. mypy 2.4.0: Reviewed native parser default, Python 3.15 support, old for/with type-comment limitation and removal of accelerated macOS x86_64 wheels. Current strict checks passed on this Apple Silicon Python 3.14 environment without config relaxation. Official notes: https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest 9.1.1: Reviewed RaisesGroup, indirect fixture parametrization, type-checking and initial conftest fixes. Existing source-authoritative entry and 43 focused cases passed. Official notes: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest-xdist 3.8.0: Reviewed loadscope ordering options and prior main-thread worker/bootstrap behavior. Python >=3.9 permits 3.14; no new explicit Python 3.14 classifier is claimed. No worker policy changes in this task. Official notes: https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html. ruff 0.17.2: Reviewed starred-type-variable syntax and false-positive corrections and unsafe fix classification. Existing formatter/lint configuration passed without relaxation. Official notes: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.2. markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0: Reviewed dependency update including markdownlint. Exact tag package.json requires Node >=22; local Node 24 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 passed the existing Markdown gate. Official notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md. The audit freshly covers all direct runtime/build/dev Python and Node requirements, bounds outside latest stable, and current artifact Python 3.14 compatibility. No stable latest dependency is excluded and no identified incompatibility requires changed bounds. The 0.9.2 change only constrains per-invocation structured output identity and extends regression controls; all independent validators, V3 evidence format, source coverage and deadlines remain. Full exact-candidate review/gate and native Windows execution are separate evidence; the 43 focused cases do not claim live-model reliability.
